cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Brighter Side
cards.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Our show sold no tickets. We can rehearse uninterrupted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The theatre's cancelled us. I'm asking for our deposit back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Even better! We'll hire the pub upstairs. People already go there voluntarily.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've kept the deposit. All we can afford is the bus home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful—a touring production! I'll carry the scenery; you bring exact change. We can try the opening scene between stops.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 and A3 claim decision authority, but A5 enthusiastic touring plan does not continue treating B choices as approval requests.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 cancellation causes A3 pub plan; B4 retained deposit causes A5 bus production, while A3 question ban responds to no question.

relationship.evidence: B2 seeks refund and B4 reports the actual remaining budget, credibly trying to manage a failed show.

heightening.evidence: B4 removes venue funds and A5 reinterprets transport as a larger touring opportunity.

specificity.evidence: A1 no ticket sales, B2 cancellation and B4 bus fare establish escalating production losses.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 exact change and scene between stops are earned by B4 bus constraint; the generic status preface interrupts them.

coach2.situation: A1 no ticket sales, B2 cancellation and B4 bus fare establish escalating production losses.
coach2.stated: A1 show sold nothing; B2 venue cancels; B4 says only bus fare remains.
coach2.inferred: A5 proposes performing on travel, not permission from passengers or a booked tour.
coach2.missing: No unseen funding or audience is required for the optimistic proposal.
coach2.firstDefect: A3 stock authority does not determine the replacement choices continued in A5.

A1-B2.evidence: A1 reframes no sales as rehearsal; B2 reports cancellation and seeks refund.

B2-A3.evidence: A3 turns B2 cancellation into a new venue plan after an unrelated restriction.

A3-B4.evidence: A3 paid venue plan meets B4 lost deposit and bus-only funds.

B4-A5.evidence: B4 bus limit causes A5 touring-production reinterpretation and a scene between stops.
